func divide(p_a int, p_b int) (int, error) {
    if (p_b == 0) {
        return 0, errors.New("division by zero")
    }
    return int(rt.ExactStore[int64](rt.ExactDiv(rt.ExactI(int64(p_a)), rt.ExactI(int64(p_b))), "return")), nil
}
